paper_id: Xue et al. - 2006 - Contour map matching for event detection in sensor networks
title: Contour Map Matching for Event Detection in Sensor Networks
motivation: 阈值方法难以指定合适的事件阈值,且无法捕获渐变型事件(如煤矿气体泄漏)
problem_framing: 将传感器网络事件检测问题重新形式化为时空模式匹配问题
key_insight: 事件在传感器网络产生时空模式,可借助等高线图实现高效模式匹配
method_signature: 基于线性回归的等高线区域合并准则进行网内等高线图构建
evaluation_criteria: 检测精度precision与recall,网络流量通信开销
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 若用户对事件缺乏完整知识,将无法准确指定属性值的时空分布
evidence_for_taste: cannot be easily captured by discrete threshold values
the communication cost on wireless radio channel is the dominating factor
combining region area with attribute value, we are able to capture the users' tradeoff
the smaller the error bound and the larger the size reduction, the larger the merging benefit
thinking_moves: 从阈值方法失败案例反推模式匹配需求
将感知问题重新frame为通信问题以强调网内聚合
用线性回归模型统一误差与面积的权衡
提出增量更新策略基于事件稀有假设
